description:
Prepare a booking link for ONE service at ONE time (a «cart» of one item). Nothing is booked here and
the time is not held: the person opens bookingUrl, checks the details, enters or corrects name, phone and
e-mail, gives the consents themselves and books. The time must be one of those get_available_slots
returns; it is checked now and again when the person confirms. If you already know the person's name,
phone and e-mail, pass them: they pre-fill the form (they travel in the link's #fragment and are not
stored by uPlanny). Cancelling and moving bookings are not available through this server.

customerPhone.description: Optional pre-fill: the person's phone, e.g. +7 999 123-45-67.

masterId.description: A particular master (from the slot's masters). Leave out for any free master.

start.description: Start time from get_available_slots (`start`, e.g. 2026-11-18T10:00+03:00). Without an offset it is read in the salon's time zone.
